data.query: Groq pricing page lists models openai/gpt-oss-20b, openai/gpt-oss-120b, qwen/qwen3.8-27b

data.code:
import json
# constants
requests = 10000
input_tokens_per_req = 800
output_tokens_per_req = 300
input_total = requests * input_tokens_per_req  # tokens
output_total = requests * output_tokens_per_req
# rates per 1M tokens
rates = {
    "openai/gpt-oss-20b": {"input": 0.075, "output": 0.30},
    "openai/gpt-oss-120b": {"input": 0.15, "output": 0.60},
    "qwen/qwen3.8-27b": {"input": 0.80, "output": 4.00}
}
results = []
for model, r in rates.items():
    cost = (input_total/1e6)*r["input"] + (output_total/1e6)*r["output"]
    results.append({"model": model, "monthly_cost": round(cost, 2)})
print(json.dumps({"results": results, "currency": "USD"}))
